notes.title: 🎮 1.10 Update Notes
notes.notes:
🎮 1.10 Update Notes
🛠️ Fixes and Improvements

Fixed the bug that caused players to get stuck in the vehicle. (Monitoring continues in case it reoccurs for different reasons.)

Leaderboard now shows the top 100 players instead of the top 50.

Players who earned money suspiciously are now hidden from the leaderboard.

Fixed a bug that caused the coin machine to display overly precise decimal numbers.

Fixed an issue where some numbers in the shopping cart showed too many decimals.

UI adjustments and updates were made.

Fixed an issue where the main menu disappeared when entering settings from the in-game menu.

Fixed the issue where trying to leave the car too close to obstacles caused players to get stuck.

⚖️ Gameplay Balancing

Earnings from vending machine tasks have been increased.

Starting money has been increased.

🆕 New Feature

Stock and Price Management app added!
Now you can view all your products, check your stock, and change prices easily from one place.
[hr][/hr]✨ Don’t forget to add our upcoming new game to your wishlist!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3861910/Krakens_Bar/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Version 1.0 Update 🎉
notes.notes:
Highlights

Italian Language Support: You can now play the game in Italian!

Leaderboard: A brand new leaderboard system has been added to ramp up the competition!

Map Controller Support: Navigate the map more comfortably with gamepad/controller support.

Custom Map Markers: You can now add and mark your own points on the map!

Bug Fixes & Improvements

Rare bug when exiting the vehicle quickly has been fixed.

Fixed issue when submitting empty offers in the negotiation screen.

Fixed problems causing items to disappear or rotate incorrectly when placing products on shelves.

Fixed issue where customers could get stuck after items were taken from the vending machine.

Translation errors have been fixed, texts are now smoother.

Collector’s Edition achievement can now be earned without issues.
[hr][/hr]
One more important announcement!

We’re collaborating with Playactive Games on a brand-new title: Krakens Bar!
With its fun mechanics and unique concept, Krakens Bar is coming soon to Steam.
Add it to your wishlist now and stay tuned for updates!

notes.title: Path to Full Release
notes.notes:
🛠️ What Have We Achieved So Far?

Hello VMBS entrepreneurs!

Since launching in Early Access we’ve been expanding and polishing the game based on your invaluable feedback. Here’s a quick look at what we’ve accomplished together:

Quality-of-life improvements with the Tablet and Quick Repair Device

Automation systems: automatic repairs, product restocking, and the defense module

Full control over your inventory with the Warehouse Management Tool

Home Decoration with brand-new items to personalise your space

Vending Machine Customisation so every machine shows off your brand

Office Expansion and dedicated vending spots

New Vending Machine Types and New Products

A Vehicle Gallery with new cars

Luck-based mini-games for extra fun and mystery boxes

City Beautification for a livelier, more detailed world

All of the above is live and playable right now ✅



🧩 Small Touch-Ups in This Patch

This build also brings a few handy tweaks:

Fixed wrong prices showing on some product boxes

Smoother item interactions inside the warehouse

Added helpful info panels for new players

Fixed an issue with bank loans

General city performance optimisations and visual updates



🏁 What’s Next?

Only one major update remains. In that update we plan to:

Give every system a final polish

Close any gaps revealed by your feedback

Add even more content variety

And then… 🎉 FULL RELEASE!

Thanks to this amazing community we’ve come this far. Every comment and bit of support has shaped the game. Now we’re one step away from the finish line.

While we can’t lock the date just yet, our target is mid-July 2025. Stay tuned! 💼🕹️

❤️ Huge thanks to you all!

notes.title: Major Update: New Cars and Mini-Games!

notes.title: Office Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Entrepreneurs!

In this update, we have activated the office building in the game. You can now interact with the boss inside to boost your vending machine sales, take on new transportation missions, and even buy out rival vending machines to drive your competition out of the city!

🏢 Office
The old office building has been revamped, and new NPC types and employees have been added. The boss will be waiting for you at the entrance—don’t forget to check in for new opportunities!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032680/9dc1e10acf04bf164ae9c7a4b16b3458647b486f.jpg
🚛 New Mission: Transportation
In addition to vending machine repair and maintenance tasks, you can now take on transportation missions. To accept a mission, visit the nearest office.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032680/6ad90f9fde4588772a39b745cc5370d66a6f2165.jpg
📢 Advertising
Billboards in the city will now display your advertisements daily, helping you maximize your sales. Of course, for a reasonable price!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032680/5494e8e32e9515649fda6da0df35957aaaf7746c.jpg
🏪 Buying Out Rival Vending Machines
With this update, you can now purchase rival vending machines and eliminate your competition in the city. However, keep in mind that if there are no competitors left, there will be no one to need vending machine maintenance! If you buy out all rival vending locations, no new maintenance jobs will appear, but you can continue taking transportation jobs every day.

🔧 Fixes
✅ [Fixed] Issue that prevented closing the map with the ESC key.
✅ [Fixed] Bug that caused events to continue for negative (-) days.
✅ [Fixed] Issue where the Effect Volume setting was not saving.
✅ [Fixed] Controller support not working in the tutorial on certain devices.
✅ [Fixed] Increased mission rewards.
✅ [Fixed] Bug where shadows of moving packages in the player’s home remained static.

⏭️ When is the Next Update?
I plan to release the next update on March 13, 2025. This update will serve as a cleanup update before the major roadmap update. Many bugs will be fixed, and general optimizations will be implemented.

Don’t forget to share your feedback and suggestions with me! 🚀

notes.notes:

Tablet Integration: You can now take on new tasks and monitor your vending machines even when you're away from your computer. Notifications about your machines will appear on your tablet screen. You can enable or disable this feature from the tablet settings anytime.

Improvements and Fixes:

notes.title: Automation and Warehouse Update
notes.notes:
Hello Entrepreneurs!

This update makes managing your warehouse and boxes easier. The Automatic Product Restocking Service is now active. In the next update, scheduled for January 4, 2025, you will get the Home Decoration feature and a Tablet to track your business while away from home.

New Warehouse Items
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032680/f8e045098a07c05e3f5c30b1446fc7d27c261976.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032680/003e4a9140d8455558c33735f46df58a1dc63c8f.png
Large Shelves: These can store up to 36 boxes and can be placed anywhere except inside your vehicle. They are required for the Automatic Product Restocking Service to work.
Portable Storage Units: These can be placed anywhere, including inside your vehicle, and can hold up to 4 boxes.
Trash Bins: Use these to dispose of garbage anywhere you want.

Automatic Product Restocking Service
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032680/72d9fa61789e2088c8e8cc50d5a06256c5252d24.png
The Automatic Product Restocking Service is now available! Here’s how it works:
Purchase the service from the Automation App.
Unlock the warehouse feature and place at least one shelf in your warehouse.
Once activated, an employee will refill vending machines when their stock drops below a certain level. They will collect the required items from your warehouse and refill your machines. The service costs $1 for every 5 products restocked.


🟢 New Features

🟢 Automatic Product Restocking Service added.
🟢 Warehouse Shelves added.
🟢 Portable Storage Units added.
🟢 Portable Trash Bins added.
🟢 Player interaction range has been shortened.
🟢 Head bobbing while walking has been added for a more realistic experience. This can be toggled in the settings.


🛠️ Bug Fixes

🛠️ Fixed an issue causing the camera to flicker when exiting vehicles.
🛠️ Resolved a problem causing the game to slow down.
🛠️ Fixed an issue preventing driving with arrow keys.
🛠️ Fixed interaction problems with houses and sidewalks.
🛠️ Fixed the day slider staying open after taking a bank loan.
🛠️ Adjusted vehicle colliders.
🛠️ Fixed an issue where the sound of customers being run over could be heard from far away.
🛠️ Fixed a bug where customers couldn’t be hit by vehicles while shopping.
🛠️ Fixed an issue where vehicles would not move after exiting and re-entering the game.
🛠️ Fixed vending machine location signs not disappearing after purchase.
🛠️ Adjusted the colors and signs of vending machine locations.
🛠️ Fixed Achievements not working on some devices.
🛠️ Fixed a bug causing product images to appear incorrectly when using empty boxes.
🛠️ Fixed an issue where boxes appeared open at the start of the game and closed later.
🛠️ Fixed a bug making trash harder to interact with.
🛠️ Resolved bugs in mini-games.
🛠️ Improved overall game performance.

notes.title: Controller Support and Key Rebinding Update
notes.notes:
Hello Players,

In this update, I’ve added controller support and key rebinding, along with some bug fixes. To accommodate these changes, the entire settings menu and in-game interaction UI have been redesigned and now feature a much sleeker look.

At this point, you can sit back and play comfortably using controllers. You might still need to use the keyboard for price and name settings. However, I plan to introduce features like an on-screen keyboard in future updates to make the game fully compatible with controllers.

Additionally, all critical and important keys in the game are now fully customizable, allowing you to adjust them to your preferences.

I’m continuing to read your feedback, and from now on, I’ll include the date and content of the next update in every patch note.

The next update is scheduled for December 16th. It will be a comprehensive update, including features like storage improvements and the Product Automation Service. I’m particularly aiming to eliminate the challenges related to box management with this update.

Lastly, here are the bug fixes:

Fixed the issue where the price tag would reset to 0 after editing prices.
Resolved the issue where the automation service would generate a $0 invoice even when unused.
Corrected several typos.

Thank you all for your support !

notes.title: Major Bug Fix and Compensation Gift!
notes.notes:
Hello players!

In this update, we have fixed some significant bugs and made various improvements to make the game more enjoyable. Additionally, we have a small gesture for you due to the issues you experienced. Here are the details:

🚫 Game Crash Issue Fixed: The bug causing the game to crash has been fixed.
📅 Task Visibility Issue: The issue where tasks did not appear when a new day started has been fixed.
☕ Coffee Machine Tasks: The bug that prevented players from completing coffee machine tasks has been resolved.
🚪 Warehouse Door: The bug where the warehouse door remained open after being unlocked has been fixed.
📦 Box Information Display: You can now see box information on the screen while carrying boxes.
⚠️ Computer Storage Warning: A warning will now be displayed again when the computer is moved to your storage.
🕹️ Sensitivity Setting Issue: The bug where the sensitivity setting was not saved correctly, causing the player to become immobile, has been fixed.
🚗 Vehicle Control: The issue preventing the vehicle from moving using the arrow keys has been resolved.
📦 Box Content Issue: The issue where the contents of some boxes changed after quitting and re-entering the game has been fixed.
🍫 Vending Machine Defense: Fixed the bug that caused attacking customers not to disappear.

Compensation Gift 🎁 We apologize for the inconvenience and would like to compensate all players with existing progress in their save files with $3000 in-game currency and removal of all bank debts. We hope this gesture enhances your enjoyment of the game.

notes.title: Update: Bug Fixes and Performance Improvements
notes.notes:
Hello players,

First and foremost, I want to let you know that I thoroughly read and review every piece of feedback about the game, regardless of the language. Every comment plays a crucial role in helping me improve the game. I am fully committed to reaching the level outlined in the roadmap and won’t stop working until we get there.

With this update, we’ve addressed several bugs and made performance improvements based on your valuable feedback. Here are the details:

🔧 Vending Machine Display Issue: Fixed the issue where sold vending machines continued to appear on the map.

🔧 Absurd Pricing Error: Resolved the bug that caused products in vending machines to be priced absurdly high (like $9999).

🔧 Icon Click Error for Sold Machines: Fixed the error that occurred when clicking on the icon of a sold vending machine that remained on the map.

🔧 Tutorial Popup Issue: Corrected the issue where the popup at the end of the tutorial wouldn’t close.

🔧 FPS Camera Error in Vehicle: Resolved the bug that caused the FPS camera to malfunction when entering the vehicle.

🔧 Vehicle and Physics Problems: Fixed the issue causing the player and items to levitate when placing a vending machine or box behind the vehicle.

🔧 Warehouse Expansion Problem: Fixed the bug that prevented purchasing warehouse expansions beyond level 2.

🔧 Market Click Issue: Resolved the problem that prevented clickable areas in the market from functioning.

🔧 New Save Security: Now, a confirmation prompt appears when starting a new save, preventing accidental loss of your save file due to misclicks.

🔧 Vehicle Movement Error: Fixed the bug that caused the vehicle to move forward or backward on its own.

Your feedback is crucial for us. In this update, we made adjustments based on your suggestions to provide a better gaming experience. Please feel free to share your thoughts with us. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Vending Machine Business Simulator Demo Update #3
notes.notes:
Hello!

We encountered some issues where save files were not updating or the game wasn’t saving on certain devices. With this update, we have transitioned to a new save system infrastructure to ensure these problems do not occur again. However, this means that old demo save files will no longer be usable, and you will need to start the game from scratch.

New Fixes and Changes 🛠️
🛠️ A new save system infrastructure has been implemented.
🛠️ Fixed a bug that caused UI elements to stay on the screen when trying to purchase a vending location.
🛠️ Resolved an issue that prevented the computer from being moved to the depot when a depot was purchased.
🛠️ Fixed a bug that prevented owned vending machines from being marked on the map on some devices.
🛠️ Fixed an issue where opening the map was triggered while trying to add a comma to the product pricing screen.
🛠️ Fixed a bug that prevented interaction with other products when the product price was not set.
🛠️ Fixed an issue that allowed negative prices (-) to be assigned to products.
🛠️ Resolved an issue where the last tutorial panel remained open indefinitely.
🛠️ Fixed an issue where the player would move backward on their own.

notes.title: Vending Machine Business Simulator Demo Update #2
notes.notes:
Hello!

Thanks to your feedback, we’re back with even more amazing updates!

✅ Vending machine doors now stop when they hit an obstacle, so you might want to move your car out of the way!
✅ To avoid getting stuck in tasks by filling all the empty shelves with a single product, you can now assign products to specific shelves after taking on a task.
✅ Vehicle sounds have been updated.
✅ Adjustments have been made to the vending machine sound levels.
✅ Rival vending machines now open only during tasks, because we should respect other people's property!
✅ Overflowing text in the main menu and settings has been fixed.
✅ We noticed the loud sounds at the start of the game were bothering you. Now, all sounds start at half volume, and you can increase them at any time in the settings.

🛠️ Fixed an issue that prevented sound when aggressive customers kicked the machine.
🛠️ Fixed an issue where the sound of a car door played when opening the cash compartment of the player’s vending machine.
🛠️ Fixed a bug that caused the player’s car to disappear.

Thank you all for your support! To stay up-to-date with the latest game news, join our Discord server below.

notes.title: Vending Machine Business Simulator New Demo Update !
notes.notes:
Hello!

We are aware of the crashing issue on some devices, and we have made updates to our technical infrastructure to address it. We will be closely monitoring this to ensure the problem does not reoccur. However, the issue might persist on a few rare devices. If you'd like to help us resolve this quickly, please join our Discord server and report your issue. Thank you!

During our demo process, we’ve been working to make our game even more enjoyable based on the feedback and suggestions you’ve provided.

New Fixes 🛠️

🛠️ Fixed an issue where successfully dismissed customers behaved erratically.
🛠️ Fixed a bug that prevented vending machine locations from being purchased.
🛠️ Fixed a bug where the vehicle could not be found when using the unstuck option in the menu.
🛠️ Adjusted vehicle physics to prevent getting stuck or clipping through walls.
🛠️ Fixed a bug where products would stack on top of each other.
🛠️ Fixed a bug preventing the purchase of the storage compartment.
🛠️ Fixed the issue where players could enter the vehicle twice.
🛠️ Fixed the issue where interacting with other objects was possible while inside the vehicle.
🛠️ Fixed text overlaps and misalignments in the price-setting panel.

New Changes ✅

✅ Leveling up is now easier.
✅ Increased the rewards from completing tasks.
✅ Reduced vending machine repair loading time by 50%.
✅ Repair mini-games have been sped up for faster gameplay.
✅ Reduced the cost of purchasing vending machine locations by $5 at every level.
✅ Removed vending machine repair covers.
✅ Updated the tutorial descriptions.
✅ We’ve heard your feedback about vehicle handling! Vehicle driving and camera settings have been revamped. Zoom in/out and auto-lock features were added, making it easier to use without constantly adjusting the mouse.
✅ The camera mode you use when exiting the vehicle now saves for each session. You can automatically return to your favorite camera mode without having to press a button each time.
✅ The size of objects on the map has been reduced to make them easier to distinguish.
✅ Pins now spread out more as you zoom in on the map.
✅ We want you to feel like you're really inside the building! Now, when inside a building, outside sounds are less noticeable.
